value.name: Daniel requests a private meeting
value.description: Daniel asks Rosa to meet him for coffee away from the house so he can apologize and ask about his mother.
evidence: "I would like to come and have coffee with you. Not at the house. At wherever you would prefer. I would like to apologize to you, in a sentence or two, for some specific things, and I would like to ask you, after that, a question about my mother that I do not feel I can ask my sister and that I cannot ask anyone else who is still alive."

value.name: Rosa hesitates before answering
value.description: Rosa pauses, reflecting on years of anticipating this conversation and her reluctance to give Daniel what he wants.
evidence: Rosa held the phone for a moment.

She had spent thirty-one years anticipating, among other things, the conversations Daniel might one day have the courage to ask her for, and she had imagined this one specifically, and the imagining of it had made her cautious.

She had imagined that when it came, if it came, she would say no, because she had decided long ago that she did not owe him the conversation and that giving it to him would cost her more than she could afford to spend.

value.name: Rosa agrees to meet at the bakery
value.description: Rosa unexpectedly agrees to meet Daniel at a bakery on Tenth Street at three o'clock.
evidence: "There is a place on Tenth Street. The bakery with the green awning. They have tables in the back. I can be there at three."
value.location_hint: the bakery with the green awning on Tenth Street

value.name: Daniel thanks Rosa for the meeting
value.description: Daniel expresses gratitude after Rosa gives him a time and place to meet.

value.name: Rosa limits the conversation
value.description: Rosa makes clear that she is only promising coffee and an apology, not necessarily an answer to Daniel's question.
evidence: "I am not promising you the answer to the question. I am promising you the coffee and the apology. The question I will decide about when I hear it."

value.name: Daniel accepts Rosa's terms
value.description: Daniel acknowledges and accepts Rosa's condition about deciding later whether to answer his question.

value.name: Rosa ends the call
value.description: Rosa hangs up after the conversation, remaining still with the receiver in her hand.
evidence: She hung up and stood for some time with her hand on the receiver

value.name: Rosa recognizes Asha's gesture
value.description: Rosa realizes her own post-call posture matches a gesture Asha made the previous day, linking their experiences.
evidence: which was, she realized, the same gesture Asha had made the day before in an office Rosa had never seen.
The gestures of people who have just said something
value.location_hint: an office Rosa had never seen
